SHOP POLICIES

The small print.

How ordering, delivery, returns and your details work at Teasire.

Delivery

We deliver within Malaysia by tracked courier and send you the tracking number on WhatsApp.

  • Signature teas are packed within 1–2 working days of payment. Custom blends are blended to order and packed within 3–5 working days.
  • After dispatch, delivery takes 2–4 working days in Peninsular Malaysia and 4–7 working days to Sabah, Sarawak and Labuan.
Peninsular MalaysiaRM8.00
SabahRM15.00
SarawakRM15.00
LabuanRM15.00
Peninsular Malaysia, orders of RM150 and aboveFree

Returns & refunds

  • Damaged, wrong or missing items: message us on WhatsApp within 7 days of delivery with a photo of the parcel and items. We’ll send a replacement or refund you in full, including delivery.
  • Change of mind: tea is a food product, so we can’t take back opened packs. Unopened signature teas can be returned within 7 days of delivery. You pay the return postage, and we refund the tea once it arrives.
  • Custom blends are made just for you, so they can’t be returned for a change of mind.
  • Refunds go back to your original payment method where available; otherwise we pay them by bank transfer or DuitNow. Refunds are made within 7 working days of approval.

Cancellations

  • Before you pay, there’s nothing to cancel: just let us know.
  • After you pay, you can cancel for a full refund until your order is packed. Custom blends can’t be cancelled once blending has started.
  • Once your order has been sent, our returns policy applies.

Terms of sale

  • Prices are in Malaysian Ringgit (RM), per pack of 10 individually packed teabags. Delivery for your location is added in your bag, with free delivery within Peninsular Malaysia on orders of RM150 and above.
  • You order by sending your bag to us on WhatsApp and paying the total shown. We confirm your order once we have checked your payment. If anything is unavailable, we refund that item in full, unless you agree to a substitute.
  • We accept DuitNow QR, including Touch ’n Go eWallet. Please pay the exact total shown in your order.
  • You can also pay online by FPX online banking, credit or debit card or eWallet through Billplz. Your order is confirmed as soon as Billplz confirms your payment.
  • Our teas are made from natural botanicals, so colour and flavour can vary slightly between batches. If an ingredient is unavailable, we’ll only use a substitute if you agree to it; otherwise we refund the unavailable item.
  • Green, black and oolong teas contain caffeine. Our teas are not medicines. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication or have allergies, check the ingredients and ask your doctor if unsure.
  • We may update these policies. The version on this page when you order applies to your order.

Privacy

  • When you send an order on WhatsApp, we receive what is in your message: your name, email, delivery details, notes and WhatsApp number. We use them only to confirm, deliver and support your order.
  • If you pay online, pressing Pay sends your order, name, email, phone number, delivery address and notes to our payment service, which runs on Cloudflare and keeps a record of the order. It passes your name, email, phone number, delivery address and a summary of your order to Billplz, our payment provider, to take your payment. This happens when you press Pay, even if you don’t finish paying. Card and bank details are entered only on Billplz’s page; we never see them.
  • After an online payment, we email your order confirmation through Resend, an email delivery service, which handles your email address and the order and delivery details in that email.
  • Your bag and saved blends are stored in your own browser, not with us. They reach us only when you send or pay for an order. When you start an online payment, a copy of your order message, including your delivery details, is also kept in your browser so we can show it after you pay. It is removed once your payment is confirmed, or the next time you visit after 24 hours.
  • We share your details only as needed to complete your order: our courier receives your name, phone number and address, and Cloudflare and Billplz receive the details described above. We never sell your details.
  • We keep order records for as long as needed for your order and our accounts. Orders sent on WhatsApp stay in our chat with you and aren’t deleted automatically. Online order records in our payment service are deleted automatically about 13 months after the order. Billplz keeps its own payment records under its privacy policy.
  • This site doesn’t use tracking or advertising cookies. It is hosted on GitHub Pages and loads its fonts from Google Fonts, so GitHub and Google receive your IP address and browser details when pages load, as with any website. WhatsApp messages are covered by WhatsApp’s own privacy policy.
  • To see, correct or delete your details, message us on WhatsApp.
